title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Schedule of Partial-Hours Earnings Rates on Weekly Payments
content:
For a weekly payment on Unemployment Benefit Claims, the earnings deduction follows the week's hours measured against the full-time hours threshold governing the week, and applies to the counted earnings above the disregard.

| Week's hours | Earnings deduction |
|---|---|
| Below 0.5 of the threshold (the low fraction) | 0.5 (the low rate) times the counted earnings above the disregard, rounded to the cent |
| At least 0.5 but below 0.75 of the threshold (the mid fraction) | 0.75 (the mid rate) times those earnings, rounded to the cent |
| At or above 0.75 of the threshold | Every dollar above the disregard |

## Bands by threshold

| Threshold | Low rate below | Mid rate from … to below | Full deduction from |
|---|---|---|---|
| 32 hours | 16.0 | 16.0 to 24.0 | 24.0 |
| 34 hours | 17.0 | 17.0 to 25.5 | 25.5 |
| 36 hours | 18.0 | 18.0 to 27.0 | 27.0 |

### Hypothetical cases (counted earnings 46.20 above the disregard, threshold 32)

10.0 hours: 23.10. 20.0 hours: 34.65. 30.0 hours: 46.20.
